title: The 5 Best Countertop Ice Makers for Small Kitchens
h1: The 5 Best Countertop Ice Makers for Small Kitchens
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for countertop ice makers for small kitchens, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at countertop ice makers for small kitchens using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Igloo Automatic Self-Cleaning Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 26 lbs of ice per 24 hours, 9 cubes ready in about 7 minutes, Automatic 5-cycle self-cleaning function.
strengths: Smallest true footprint in this list, fits a narrow counter strip or a cart
Self-cleaning cycle reduces the maintenance most small-kitchen owners skip
9 cubes in 7 minutes is fast enough that you never wait long for a refill
limitations: 1-quart reservoir needs refilling every day or two with regular use
Bullet-shaped ice melts faster than nugget or cube ice in a drink
Plastic housing feels less premium than stainless steel competitors
features: Large or small cube size selector

products.name: Frigidaire Countertop Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 26 lbs of bullet-shaped ice per day, 9 pieces in about 7 minutes, Black stainless finish.
strengths: Usually the least expensive model that still produces 26 lbs a day
Compact enough to tuck onto an end-of-counter corner
Recognized appliance brand with wide parts and support availability
limitations: No WiFi or app, purely manual operation
Bullet ice is thin-walled and melts quickly once scooped
Fan noise is noticeable in a very quiet room
features: 26 lbs of bullet-shaped ice per day

products.name: Euhomy Nugget Ice Maker Countertop
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day, First batch ready in about 6 minutes, Self-cleaning cycle.
strengths: Chewable nugget ice in a machine barely larger than the compact bullet-ice models
34 lbs a day is enough output for a small household plus occasional guests
Removable top cover simplifies cleaning versus sealed-lid designs
limitations: Still noticeably taller and deeper than the Igloo or Frigidaire
Louder compressor cycle than bullet-ice machines
Price runs higher than basic bullet-ice models
features: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day
First batch ready in about 6 minutes
Removable top cover for easy access

products.name: GE Profile Opal 2.0 Nugget Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 38 lbs of nugget ice per 24 hours, 0.75-gallon side water tank, WiFi with SmartHQ app and Alexa/Google voice control.
strengths: The side tank means fewer refills than any other model in this list
38 lbs a day covers a household that fills a pitcher and a cooler in the same day
App scheduling and maintenance alerts are a genuine convenience feature
limitations: Roughly 15 inches wide with the tank attached, the widest footprint here
Overkill for a kitchen that only needs ice for a few drinks a day
features: 38 lbs of nugget ice per 24 hours
WiFi with SmartHQ app and Alexa/Google voice control
First batch ready in about 10 minutes

products.name: EUHOMY Countertop Bullet Ice Maker, 26 lb/Day
strengths: Carry handle for RVs and parties
limitations: Ice melts in the unrefrigerated basket

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
